description: Main entry point and primary UI code for the Flutter-based AI Tutor application. It sets up theming, app shell with bottom navigation, and home dashboard with various interactive components.

classes.name: AiTutorApp
classes.description: Root widget for the AI Tutor app that configures theming and manages the main scaffold with bottom navigation.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: StatefulWidget controlling navigation between main sections via bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: HomeDashboardScreen
classes.description: Main dashboard UI with sections for topic selection, quiz, and chat interface.

classes.name: _CardContainer
classes.description: Reusable styled container resembling a card with border and shadow for consistent UI layout.

classes.name: _SectionTitle
classes.description: Styled widget for section headers within the dashboard.

classes.name: _SelectableChip
classes.description: Stateful widget representing a selectable pill-shaped chip for topics.

classes.name: _InputPill
classes.description: Styled TextField mimicking a chat input pill.

classes.name: _CenteredPlaceholder
classes.description: Generic placeholder widget for empty tab states, with icon and descriptive text.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that bootstraps the Flutter app with the AiTutorApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for each widget class, constructing the corresponding UI.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Method to trigger UI update within stateful widgets, e.g., when changing selected chips or navigation index.
